title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — September 21, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.0)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B6.8 (Peaked September 21, 2026 at 11:17 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 328 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.67)

How's the Sun looking from where you are? 🌞🖤

A broad coronal-hole-like region stands out in today’s otherwise quiet solar disk.

Images: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195, 284, 171, 304, 131, 094 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
